construct: uniform align-items: baseline on a flex row of two differing font sizes
why: `baseline` is a documented CARRY-BOTH value of LayoutSchema.align — packages/core/src/anatomy.ts lowers it to CSS and emit-figma-script lowers it to counterAxisAlignItems BASELINE (with the VERTICAL -> MIN projection). Only the DETECTION map lacked the entry, so the keyword left as `layout-value-outside-vocabulary` and antd.checkbox, antd.radio, astryx.progress-bar and carbon.modal all minted with the counter-axis default instead.

canvas.note: counterAxisAlignItems BASELINE is native on a HORIZONTAL auto-layout frame
